summary: Clarify consequential uncertainty or prototype the smallest discriminating experiment.

skills.choose_when: Requirements are materially ambiguous, conflicting, high-impact, or the user explicitly asks for requirement clarification.
skills.avoid_when: Do not trigger merely because any task could benefit from more detail; inspect available context first.
skills.name: clarify-requirements

skills.choose_when: A prototype, spike, proof of concept, or experiment is needed to answer one named uncertainty.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use when the user expects production-ready implementation without a learning goal.
skills.name: prototype-solution
